calls.title: Product Analytics UX Bug Bash
calls.summary: The team discussed significant UI/UX enhancements to simplify the user interface and improve user flow. Key changes include eliminating confusing empty states by defaulting to one visible metric, streamlining the metric selection UI by removing unnecessary unit dropdowns, and adding friction to data source tab switches to prevent accidental data loss. They also focused on improving graph responsiveness with auto-refresh capabilities for Managed Warehouse data sources and clarifying rules for metric stacking and grouping to ensure data readability. The discussion included a roadmap for demo preparation, targeting a February release, with iterations based on feedback. Ongoing documentation will be managed via Notion, with specific responsibilities assigned to team members.
calls.keywords: metric selection, fact table, SQL exploration, UI/UX improvements, auto-run queries, group by functionality

calls.title: Product Analytics UX Bug Bash
calls.summary: The meeting addressed user experience and interface improvements for a data exploration tool, emphasizing the removal of confusing empty states and the automatic addition of a default metric to streamline user onboarding. The team discussed replacing the plus icon with clearer call-to-action elements to enhance usability and proposed a confirmation prompt when switching data sources to prevent accidental data loss. Enhancements included evolving the empty state into a full-page hub for better context, refining the metric and filter configurations for a balance between power and simplicity, and simplifying chart options for clearer data storytelling. The team set a target launch date for February, with ongoing iterations and demos planned to ensure readiness before release.
calls.keywords: Metrics, Fact Table, SQL Exploration, Auto-Update, Group By, User Interface
